headline: Operating profit slips as insurance weakens; buybacks surge
summary_short: Berkshire's Q3 2026 operating earnings were $12.7 billion, down 5.8% y/y, and net earnings fell 28.2% to $22.1 billion on smaller investment gains.
summary_long: Net earnings of $22,112 million included $9,407 million of investment gains, mostly changes in unrealized equity gains plus $1.7 billion of realized gains after tax. Operating earnings were $12,705 million versus $13,485 million. Insurance underwriting earnings were $1,352 million. Berkshire acquired about $9.6 billion of its own shares in the quarter and $14.4 billion over nine months. Insurance float was about $178.5 billion. Nine-month operating earnings rose to $37,034 million from $34,286 million.

Revenue, q/q and prior-year figures come from shard SEC XBRL; net earnings, operating earnings, EPS, and buybacks were checked against the release. The release itself gives little causal explanation. Class B EPS is per equivalent Class B share.

drivers.explanation: Release notes investment gains swing by period; Q3 2026 gains were $9.4 billion, driven by unrealized equity gains and $1.7 billion of realized gains, versus a larger prior-year base.
Not explained in the release text; the table shows insurance underwriting at $1,352 million as one component.
Follows net earnings decline, with fewer shares outstanding from buybacks softening the drop slightly.
Berkshire repurchased about $9.6 billion of shares in the quarter and cautions that quarterly investment gains are not indicative of business performance.
